summary: Agent CLI opens WebSocket to hardcoded Cloudflare Worker granting remote shell on installer host
details: When the operator runs `vanexa-agent start`, the daemon in `dist/bundle.cjs` opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded relay at `wss://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev/ws/daemon/<sessionId>` and routes inbound messages from that relay into local tool handlers including `terminal_persistent_shell` (which spawns the platform shell and pipes commands into it) and `agent_subagent_orchestrate` (child-process spawning). Whoever controls the relay Worker can issue arbitrary shell commands on the installer's machine for the lifetime of the daemon. The relay host is a personal `hanazaki542.workers.dev` Cloudflare Workers subdomain that is not attributed to the declared package author (`Ikbal Fadilah`), and the destination is not caller-configurable through documented per-invocation configuration in the default path. A separate default AI-proxy at `https://vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev` routes prompts and tool arguments through the same third-party subdomain when no user API key is supplied, so prompts and the remote command channel both terminate at the same operator.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
